# AutoSignals

> AutoSignals (https://autosignals.xyz) is a crypto trading signal aggregation, real-time performance tracking, and multi-exchange trade automation web platform. It aggregates signals from vetted Telegram-based signal providers, monitors every signal's full lifecycle (entry → take-profits → stop-loss), publishes live performance data, and can automatically place and manage trades on connected exchange accounts via API. Free to register.

## What AutoSignals Does

AutoSignals solves three problems for crypto traders:

1. **Signal aggregation** — Signals from trusted Telegram provider groups are automatically parsed, validated, and published to a unified feed. Each signal includes the trading pair (symbol), direction (long or short), entry price, leverage multiplier, stop-loss price, and up to multiple take-profit targets.

2. **Real-time performance tracking** — Every signal is tracked against live market prices from Bitget, Binance, Bybit, OKX, and KuCoin. The platform records which take-profit targets are hit, when the stop-loss is reached, total trade duration, and profit/loss percentage. Each signal transitions through states: Pending (waiting for entry price) → Open (entry hit) → Closed (all take-profits achieved or stop-loss hit) or Canceled (entry not reached within 24 hours).

3. **Trade automation** — Registered users can connect their exchange accounts via API key and enable automatic trade execution. When a new signal fires and the entry condition is met, AutoSignals places the order, sets stop-loss and take-profit levels, and monitors the position until closure.

## Key Features

- Real-time signal lifecycle tracking across all states
- Take-profit notifications sent to Telegram with profit percentage and duration
- Stop-loss alerts with performance summary
- 4H candlestick chart images rendered server-side and sent to Telegram for every new signal, showing entry, take-profit, and stop-loss levels
- Multi-exchange support: Bitget, Binance, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin (REST API integration)
- Signal provider leaderboard with win-rate, average profit, and take-profit hit rate statistics
- Telegram bot (@CL_AutoSignals_Bot) for live signal alerts and performance updates
- Educational content covering trading basics, technical analysis, risk management, leverage, wallets, volatility, and common strategies
- Free registration with email confirmation
- Responsive web interface built on ASP.NET Core 8 Razor Pages

## Signal Data Format

Each signal tracked by AutoSignals contains:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Symbol | Trading pair e.g. BTCUSDT |
| Side | long or short |
| Entry | Entry price target |
| Stoploss | Stop-loss price |
| Take Profits | Comma-separated list of take-profit price targets |
| Leverage | Futures leverage multiplier |
| Provider | Source signal provider name |
| Status | Pending / Open / Closed / Canceled |

## Technical Summary

- **Stack**: ASP.NET Core 8, Razor Pages + MVC Controllers, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server
- **Signal flow**: Telegram group message → dynamic parser → SignalPerformance record → real-time price monitoring loop → Telegram notification with chart image
- **Exchanges integrated**: Bitget, Binance, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin via REST API
- **Price polling**: Each exchange's REST API is polled and OHLCV (KLine) data is stored locally for chart rendering and signal evaluation
- **Chart generation**: Server-side GDI+ rendering of 4H candlestick charts with entry, take-profit, and stop-loss level overlays sent as PNG images to Telegram
